target_customer: Engineering teams that run CI on GitHub Actions and pay per runner minute
problem: GitHub Actions hosted runners are slow and relatively expensive, and CI workflows rarely get optimized after they are written.
business_model: usage-based per minute runners, plus review runners and enterprise contracts
product_category: Developer tools, CI runners with AI agents

founders.name: Yonas Beshawred
founders.background_notes: Education not stated on the YC page.

founders.name: Daniel Worku
prior_employers: Netflix (led the team that built the Internal Developer Portal)
founders.background_notes: Education not stated on the YC page.

competitors.name: Depot
competitors.what: Faster GitHub Actions runners switched in by changing the runs-on key

competitors.name: Blacksmith
competitors.what: Managed bare-metal runners that replace GitHub hosted runners in place
competitors.traction_then: A team reported moving to it in early 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Running reliable fleets of ephemeral runners on EPYC hardware is standard but operationally hard, and the agent layer that opens optimization PRs adds moderate AI work.

defensibility.rationale: Drop-in runners are easy to swap out, and several vendors already sold the same wedge when StarSling started, so differentiation rests on the agent layer and price.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: GitHub itself sells larger hosted runners and the product category was crowded with third party runner vendors by 2025. The sources do not show an incumbent buying or copying StarSling.

market_need_then: Teams complained about GitHub Actions cost and speed and a market of third party runner vendors had formed by 2024 and 2025, as the competitor sources show.

branding.domain_note: Uses starsling.dev, not a .com. No acquisition history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, focused on speed and cost

brand_strength.rationale: Young brand with no found press about the brand itself. The founders carry credibility from StackShare but the name is not yet a growth driver.

outcome_analysis: StarSling is active and early. Experienced founders with a prior exit raised a reported $3M pre-seed with Bessemer and Y Combinator in 2026 while selling into a crowded market of faster CI runners, so its edge depends on the AI agent layer rather than the runners themselves. No outcome beyond fundraising is public yet.
notes: Funding sources conflict: runtimewire says $3M with Bessemer and Y Combinator (article dated 2026-09-22, close date not stated); a Dealroom snippet says $1.94M; aggregators list $500K in 2025. Only the $3M figure has a readable article and is recorded as a round, the others are unverified. The round stage is labeled pre_seed per the article headline. Outcome search for StarSling returned nothing relevant. Founder education not found. Name origin not found.
